classification: exploratory retained-output evidence; not formal thesis evidence

status.observed: the last arrival has label 2401 s; under the declared strict before-step convention, the 2401 row still contains that vehicle and the first later retained 30 s row (2430) is empty
status.calculated: before-step vehicle conservation and aligned 30 s timeline

definitions.timeline_state: Trip-derived accounts only: at label t, scheduled < t, depart < t, arrival < t; waiting=scheduled-entered; in_network=entered-arrived.
definitions.fcd_time_semantics: FCD and TLS retain their exact raw labels; they are not asserted to share the trip-derived before-step boundary.
definitions.stopped: FCD speed <= 0.1 m/s from authoritative accounting_v2
definitions.e1: Raw 30 s intervals [begin,end); flow veh/h, speed m/s, occupancy percent.
definitions.tls: Exact original time label only; no shifting or causal phase attribution.

paired_repair.role: measurement-repair regression evidence; not a performance comparison

limitations: One seed and one high trajectory; 30 s rows are repeated observations, not replications.
Low demand differs in demand and duration and is not a matched causal comparator.
Outside-network vehicles have counts only and no invented coordinates.
At 2700, FCD/TLS have no exact label; trip-based state is retained and detector interval ends at 2700.
